candidate.initialization: from scratch; no teacher weights or pseudo-label training in the first bounded experiment
candidate.frameTimestamp: integer end sample of a trailing window; no centered FFT or timestamp backdating
candidate.normalization: one-second causal EMA mean/variance, initialized from training-only statistics; use prior state then update; identical training and streaming procedure
candidate.frequencyEncoder: two frequency-only convolution stages followed by a 64-channel projection

temporalEncoder.direction: past only; depthwise temporal convolution and pointwise residual projection

candidate.postprocessing: one subsequent frame for local onset confirmation; class-specific calibration on development only; no extra tempo hits or generic-energy semantic substitution
candidate.noveltyStatus: same broad causal-convolution family as the old student; materially different proposed frontend, frequency encoder, objectives, classes and supervised data. No new checkpoint or benchmark novelty is claimed.

officialMetricsRequire: accurate sample-bound onset labels and timing uncertainty
referencePolicy.publishedMdbStatus: historical reference scoring only; completeness and checkpoint overlap unresolved
referencePolicy.teacherPredictions: not verified ground truth; excluded from first candidate training
referencePolicy.favoriteSongs: not training, threshold selection or candidate selection targets
referencePolicy.holdoutPolicy: keep existing partitions fixed; after data readiness freeze all decisions before one candidate holdout evaluation

proposedRecognitionMargins.limitations: Margins are proposals pending adequate development evidence; no new score or noninferiority pass is asserted. Matching tolerances are reused, not tuned to a candidate.

statisticalDecision.pairBy: same recording and coverage; drum-only/full-mix variants clustered together
statisticalDecision.estimand: Per-class pooled micro metrics within each domain separately: aggregate TP/FP/FN over recording groups, then compute candidate minus H0. Rate deltas use total false events divided by total eligible negative minutes. These are event/exposure-weighted estimands, not equally weighted per-recording metric means.
statisticalDecision.clusterSampling: Sample original recording groups uniformly with replacement; keep candidate/H0 paired and all related assets together. Score drum-only and full-mix domains separately; never count them as independent recordings.
statisticalDecision.confidence: one-sided 95% paired recording-cluster bounds only where sampling, event exposure and complete coverage support them
statisticalDecision.benefitRule: For F1/precision/recall noninferiority, each required lower one-sided 95% confidence bound of candidate minus H0 must be at least the predeclared negative margin
statisticalDecision.harmRule: For natural Cymbal-only/vocal-negative Hat false-event rate increases, each upper one-sided 95% confidence bound of candidate minus H0 must be at most the proposed 0.1 event/minute tolerance. This tolerance remains unlocked until adequate development evidence is reviewed.
statisticalDecision.deterministicControls: Exact complete generated Snare-only controls require no more false Hats than frozen H0; complete silence/sustained controls require zero semantic events; duplicate class/sample and stale-generation counts must be zero. These are deterministic assertions on the tested inputs, not confidence-bound claims about a population.
statisticalDecision.insufficientEvidenceRule: Missing/ambiguous labels, undefined denominators, inadequate independent clusters or inadequate rare-error exposure remain BLOCKED. A degenerate all-zero bootstrap does not certify a zero population error rate; a valid rare-event uncertainty method or more exposure must be specified before locking that gate.
statisticalDecision.onsetRule: reuse maximum-cardinality minimum-error one-to-one natural matching capped at 50ms and quarter-nearest-reference spacing; constructed cap 40ms. Also report signed/absolute errors, unmatched predictions, rapid bins and denominators
statisticalDecision.multipleClasses: all mandatory gates must pass; no aggregate F1 substitutes for a failed row

trainingAdmission.checkpointSelection: development-only class-balanced objective, fixed before training; no holdout or user-song selection
trainingAdmission.failAction: stop and report; no compensating threshold sweep

runtimeAdmission.scope: aspirational budgets, not measured feasibility; evaluate both incremental and whole combined app/browser processes

promotion.rollback: existing L0; H0 remains exact-source offline reference
promotion.fallback: no qualified semantic engine means explicit unavailable or existing decorative playback feedback; no fabricated semantic events
